purpose: Prepare and execute the first real rig-relay live pull request mutation for a code scanning alert fix.
prerequisites: GitHub App installed on target repository with contents:write and pull_requests:write permissions
Operator checklist reviewed and all gates passed

environment_variables.name: RIG_LIVE_MUTATION
environment_variables.description: Master gate flag; must be set to 1 to enable any remote mutation

environment_variables.name: RIG_GITHUB_AUTH_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: GitHub personal access token or installation token

cli_commands.live_execution: RIG_LIVE_MUTATION=1 RIG_LIVE_AUTH_TESTS=1 RIG_GITHUB_PERMISSION_MODE=write uv run python scripts/rig_github_security_packet_execution.py   --plan-json docs/json/governance/github_security_packet_runner_plan_v1.v1.json   --output-json docs/json/governance/github_security_packet_execution_v1.v1.json   --limit 1 --summary

gate_checklist.command_to_verify: cat docs/json/governance/github_live_mutation_preflight_v1.v1.json | uv run python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('status',''))"
cat docs/json/governance/github_live_mutation_phase3_permission_boundary_audit_v1.v1.json | uv run python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('gates_passed',''))"
cat docs/json/governance/github_live_mutation_rate_limit_snapshot_v1.v1.json | uv run python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('rate_limited',''))"

cat docs/json/governance/github_live_mutation_operator_checklist_v1.v1.json | uv run python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); acks=d.get('operator_acknowledgements',[]); print(len(acks)==8)"
cat docs/json/governance/code_scanning_dry_run_candidate_diff_v1.v1.json | uv run python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('diff_sha256','')[:8])"

expected_artifacts.purpose: Operator checklist — must be reviewed before execution
Preflight probe results — gates permission and rate limit status
Permission boundary audit — verifies required scopes are active
Dry-run candidate diff — the proposed change being promoted to live
Rate limit snapshot — confirms headroom before mutation
Lifecycle replay — end-to-end dry-run before live promotion

expected_blocked_states.reason: One or more preflight gates failed (permissions, rate limit, branch collision)
expected_blocked_states.resolution: Resolve the failing gate and re-run preflight before proceeding

expected_blocked_states.reason: GitHub API rate limit near or at exhaustion
expected_blocked_states.resolution: Wait for rate limit reset window. Re-run rate limit snapshot.

expected_blocked_states.reason: Required GitHub App permissions not granted or token expired
expected_blocked_states.resolution: Re-install GitHub App or refresh token. Re-run permission boundary audit.

expected_blocked_states.reason: Proposed branch name already exists on remote
expected_blocked_states.resolution: Choose a new branch name or delete the stale branch if safe.

expected_blocked_states.reason: Operation idempotency key already recorded as executed
expected_blocked_states.resolution: Review the previous execution receipt. If intentional re-execution, generate new idempotency key.

success_criteria: Remote branch rig/security/code-scanning-fix-001 created on the target repository
File change committed to the remote branch with correct diff contents
Pull request opened with title referencing code scanning alert fix
Operation receipt generated and persisted to docs/json/governance/
No secrets, tokens, or raw vulnerable code present in any persisted artifact
Rate limits not exhausted by the operation
Alert state explicitly documented as deferred (not dismissed, not fixed)

rollback_steps.command: gh pr close <PR_NUMBER> --comment "Rollback: per operator checklist rollback procedure."
rollback_steps.description: Close the pull request without merging

rollback_steps.command: Ensure operation receipt at docs/json/governance/github_code_scanning_pr_operation_receipt_v1.v1.json is preserved with rollback annotation
rollback_steps.description: Preserve operation receipt as canonical evidence

post_review_steps: Review the pull request diff for correctness and unintended changes
Confirm the branch prefix matches rig/security/
Verify no workflow files (.github/workflows/) were modified
Verify no default branch write occurred
Check that the operation receipt is content-light (no secrets, tokens, raw code)
Document the alert state deferral reason in the PR body
Schedule alert state update for post-merge validation lane
alert_deferred_explanation: Code scanning alert state update/dismissal requires separate security_events:write permission and is deferred to post-merge validation.

troubleshooting.cause: Environment variable not exported or shell session not refreshed
Token expired, invalid, or missing required permissions
troubleshooting.resolution: Refresh token. Re-run permission boundary audit. Check GitHub App installation.
Check X-RateLimit-Reset header. Wait for reset window. Re-run rate limit snapshot.

troubleshooting.cause: Proposed branch name collision with existing remote branch
troubleshooting.resolution: Verify branch safety. Delete stale branch if safe, or choose new branch name.

troubleshooting.cause: Base branch has diverged from the expected SHA
troubleshooting.resolution: Re-run dry-run candidate diff generation against current base branch HEAD.

rate_limit_handling: GitHub API rate limits are monitored via event fabric. Near-exhaustion triggers polling cadence reduction. Exhaustion triggers graceful degradation.
privacy_posture: No raw file contents, tokens, or secrets in operation receipts. Content-light evidence only.
stop_conditions: Permission boundary audit shows required permission not_granted
Operator checklist has not been fully acknowledged
Idempotency key collision detected (operation already executed)
Branch safety check fails (proposed branch exists on remote)
